forecast.detailed_text: North wind 15 to 25 knots rising to up to 30 knots after midnight. Chance of sprinkles through around midnight, then slight chance of rain and snow after midnight. Waves 6 to 8 feet subsiding to 5 to 7 feet in the late evening and overnight.

North wind 15 to 25 knots backing northwest 15 to 20 knots after midnight. Partly cloudy through around midnight then becoming mostly cloudy. Waves 4 to 6 feet subsiding to 3 to 4 feet.

Northwest wind 15 to 20 knots veering north 10 to 20 knots early in the afternoon, then becoming 10 to 15 knots late in the afternoon. Partly sunny. Waves 3 to 4 feet. Wave heights are for ice free areas.

alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the Gale Warning, north winds 25 to 30 kt with
gusts up to 35 kt and waves 6 to 11 ft. For the Small Craft
Advisory, north winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
waves 6 to 9 ft expected.

* WHERE...Nearshore Waters from Sheboygan to North Point
Lighthouse.

* WHEN...For the Gale Warning, until 5 PM CST this afternoon.
For the Small Craft Advisory, until midnight CST Friday night.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous waves which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
